title: The Law Amending the Myanmar Investment Law
text:
(Official Translation)
The Law Amending the Myanmar Investment Law
(The Pyidaungsu Hluttaw Law No. 19/ 2019)
th
4 , Waxing of Nayon, 1381 M.E.
(6 June 2019)
The Pyidaungsu Hluttaw hereby enacts this Law.
1. This Law shall be called the Law Amending the Myanmar Investment Law.
2. Sub-section (d) of section 2 of the Myanmar Investment Law shall be substituted
as follows:
“(d) Ministry means the Ministry of Investment and Foreign Economic Relations
of the Union Government.”
3. The expression “Ministry of Planning and Finance” contained in the introduction of
Section 99 of the Myanmar Investment Law shall be substitute by the expression
“Ministry”.
I hereby sign in accord with the Constitution of the Republic of the Union of
Myanmar.
Sd/ Win Myint
President
The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
